item.title: Publishing Scotland Prize for Stirling M. Litt. Publishing Studies Best Dissertation 2025
item.description: The Publishing Scotland Prize for Stirling M. Litt. Publishing Studies Best Dissertation 2025 has been won by Racheal Kizza, for ‘The Influence of the Caine Prize for African Writing on the Visibility and Career Trajectories of East African Women’. The post Publishing Scotland Prize for Stirling M. Litt. Publishing Studies Best Dissertation 2025 appeared first on Publishing Scotland.

item.title: Publishing Scotland signs new Publishing Inclusion Pledge
item.description: We are proud to support the Publishing Inclusion Pledge 2026-28, a new initiative which recognises and celebrates that diverse perspectives strengthen the UK’s publishing sector. The post Publishing Scotland signs new Publishing Inclusion Pledge appeared first on Publishing Scotland.

item.title: Interview with Publishing Scotland CEO Sheila Pinder published in The Herald Scotland
item.description: Today our CEO Sheila Pinder's interview with Dominic Ryan was published in The Herald Scotland. Sheila shares insights into the diverse structure of the industry, and the value of its perseverance in the face of funding struggles and AI-related copyright fears. The post Interview with Publishing Scotland CEO Sheila Pinder published in The Herald Scotland appeared first on Publishing Scotland.
